201.description: Associate assigned. Location points at this associate's assignment resource (at most one active assignment exists per associate, so the collection URI identifies it).

Location.description: URI of the associate's assignment resource.

activePathId.description: The path of the current active assignment, if any.

active.description: Whether the associate currently has an active assignment.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, or a required field was missing/empty (empty-associate-id, empty-path-id, empty-certification, missing-building-id, missing-shift-id, missing-charge, or malformed-request-body). On the two Idempotency-Key-protected routes (POST /shift-plans, POST /associates/{id}/assignments) a missing Idempotency-Key header is also a 400 (idempotency-key-required).

409.description: Conflict — the associate lacks the required certification for this path (certification-required), is currently on a logged break (associate-on-break), their shift has ended (associate-shift-ended), closing the prior active assignment would push logged hours over the configured max per shift (max-hours-exceeded), or this associate's roster entry or active assignment was concurrently modified by another request between when it was read and when this write was attempted (concurrent-modification, ADR 0021); reload and retry.
